Subject: Post-discovery recap + propose 30min demo windows

Hi Sara and Tom,

Thanks again for taking the time today — really helpful to understand Lumenix Health's priorities. Quick recap from our side and a suggested set of next steps so we can lock in a brief product intro (30 minutes) with the right stakeholders.

Recap (high level):
- Primary use case: patient record summarization and semantic search across clinical notes (multi-region).
- Key constraints: data residency for EU/US, SOC 2 evidence required, low single-digit second 95th percentile latency for search calls.
- Value drivers: reduce clinician time per chart review, improve coder productivity.

Suggested agenda for the 30-min intro:
1) 10m product walkthrough (UI + API)
2) 10m how we handle residency/secure deployments and SLA options
3) 5m integration pattern and next steps
4) 5m Q&A / action items

Proposed 30-minute windows (Pacific Time) — pick one or tell me alternatives:
- Wed Mar 22, 11:00–11:30 AM PT
- Thu Mar 23, 9:30–10:00 AM PT
- Fri Mar 24, 2:00–2:30 PM PT

Attachments: I attached a short discovery notes PDF and a draft mutual action plan (DOCX) that outlines milestones if we move forward.

If any of those slots work I’ll send a calendar invite and bring Jordan (solutions engineer) for the tech part and Priyom (CSM) for next steps. If you prefer a separate deep-dive instead of a 30-minute intro, flag that — we can schedule a longer technical session after this intro.

Thanks — looking forward to locking something in.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
